text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I see Mejiro Dober buying<n>essential oils
in bulk at the mall.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Lavender helps with falling asleep...<n>Cypress helps
with relaxation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eucalyptus aids with concentration...<n>And rose and
lemongrass...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just get one of<n>everything. It's
starting to look like I<n>need them all...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems extremely tired.<n>Maybe it's
best to ease off of racing<n>for now.
